main_instruction: Convert the uploaded product photo into a luxury minimalist product poster using the provided reference poster as the exact layout and style guide. The final output must look like the reference poster in composition, spacing, background, logo placement, product placement, typography, and overall catalog presentation. Only replace the product images and the editable product information text.

USER_TEXT_INPUT.spec_1: Measurement: W 145cm x L 145cm x H 115cm

reference_usage.instruction: Use the uploaded reference poster as the exact layout guide.
use_reference_for: clean white and soft gray background
reference_usage.important_rule: Follow the reference poster as closely as possible. Replace only the product and editable text.

left_side.instruction: Replace the large close-up product image on the left side with a close-up crop of the newly uploaded product.
left_side.placement: same left-side position as the reference poster

right_side.instruction: Replace the smaller full product/model photo on the right side with a full view of the newly uploaded product.
right_side.placement: same right-side position as the reference poster

text_area.instruction: Replace the item name, product type, and specs with the exact values from USER_TEXT_INPUT.
text_area.placement: same lower-right text placement as the reference poster
text_area.font: match the same clean bold modern sans-serif font style used in the reference

logo.instruction: Maintain the HomeCartel logo exactly as shown in the reference poster.

composition.background: clean white studio background with soft light gray vertical panel division, matching the reference
composition.left_panel: large close-up product crop filling most of the left side
composition.right_panel: smaller full product image with generous white space
composition.logo_position: upper right area, exactly like the reference
composition.text_position: below the smaller product image on the right side, exactly like the reference
composition.mood: luxury, minimalist, clean, editorial, premium product catalog

product_preservation.instruction: Preserve the actual design of the uploaded product.
preserve: lighting elements if the product is a lamp or chandelier
do_not: do not invent a different product
do not change the product category
do not remove important product details

text_rules.render_only: Render only the final values typed inside USER_TEXT_INPUT.

lighting_and_quality.image_quality: high-resolution, sharp, polished, premium catalog image

final_output.description: A vertical 9:16 luxury minimalist product poster that looks like the provided reference poster. The left side shows a large close-up crop of the uploaded product, the right side shows a smaller full product image, the HomeCartel logo stays exactly in place, and the lower-right text area uses only the user-provided item name, product type, and specs.
